speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I need to understand the onset and severity of the newborn's respiratory distress to narrow down the differential diagnosis. When did the symptoms begin, and has the baby been cyanotic or requiring oxygen support since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the prematurity at 33 weeks and early onset of respiratory distress, Respiratory Distress Syndrome is highly likely. I will order tests to confirm this and rule out other causes like pneumonia or pneumothorax. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray REQUEST TEST: Blood_Gas_Analysis
